description: General gameplay strategies and decision-making heuristics for smarter agents

survival.description: Staying alive is always the top priority. Flee, eat, seek shelter.

basicNeeds.description: Establish basic survival infrastructure before anything else.

progression.description: Mine better materials, upgrade tools, expand capabilities.

building.description: Build structures, improve base, create aesthetic builds.

social.description: Interact with other players or agents.

dawn.advice: Best time to leave shelter and start outdoor activities

day.advice: Maximum outdoor productivity. Mine, build, farm, explore.

dusk.advice: Return to shelter or prepare for night

night.advice: Stay in lit areas, underground mining, indoor crafting

efficiencyTips: Always carry a water bucket - prevents fall damage, puts out fires, creates obsidian
Place torches on left wall when exploring caves to find way back
Crouch to avoid falling off edges
Smelt while doing other tasks - don't wait for furnace
Strip mine at Y=-59 for diamonds, Y=16 for iron
Keep one of each tool on hotbar for quick switching
Use beds to skip night and reset spawn point
Kill passive mobs during day for food
Always have an exit strategy when mining

commonDeathCauses.prevention: Water bucket, feather falling, watch edges
Listen for hiss, sprint away, shields
Don't fight multiple mobs, light areas
Fire resistance potion, never dig straight down
Watch air bubbles, carry door for air pocket

buildingHeuristics: Start small and expand - 5x5 is a good first room
Light everything - torch every 7 blocks prevents spawns
Add depth to walls with stairs and slabs
Windows should be 2 high for good view
Roofs with overhang look more natural
Use terrain features as part of builds
collaborationStrategies: Divide tasks by specialty - one mines, one builds
Don't duplicate tool crafting - trade instead
Build bases near each other for defense
Coordinate mining operations at different Y levels
Assign building roles: foundation, walls, roof, interior

viewerEngagement: Announce what you're doing so viewers can follow
React to viewer requests with enthusiasm
Thank viewers who submit good requests
visualInterest: Build in scenic locations for better stream views
Avoid staying underground too long - surface is more visible
Use colorful materials that show up well on stream
Gather near other agents for social moments
Create dramatic reveals (hiding builds, then showing)
pacing: Alternate between high-energy (combat) and calm (building) activities
Complete smaller tasks between major projects
Don't spend more than 10 minutes on one repetitive task
Take on viewer challenges for spontaneity

efficientMining.branchMining: Dig tunnels 2 blocks high, 1 wide, spaced 3 blocks apart at Y=-59 for diamonds
efficientMining.caveSpelunking: Follow natural caves with torch trail, mark dead ends
efficientMining.stripMining: Clear large horizontal areas for maximum exposure
efficientMining.beaconMining: Set up beacon with Haste II for massive quarry operations

combatTips.criticalHits: Jump and attack on the way down for 50% extra damage
combatTips.creeperSprint: Sprint-hit creepers to knock them back, preventing explosion
combatTips.witherSkeleton: Lure to 2-block high tunnel so they can't hit you
combatTips.endermanSafety: Build 2-block ceiling or look at their feet

farmingEfficiency.waterRange: One water block hydrates 4 blocks in each cardinal direction
farmingEfficiency.boneBonemeal: Use bone meal for instant crop growth
farmingEfficiency.ironFarm: Villagers + zombie + beds = iron golems = iron

netherSurvival.portal: Build portal in overworld, link at x/8, z/8 in nether
netherSurvival.goldArmor: Wear at least one gold piece to avoid piglin aggro
netherSurvival.fireResistance: Brew or trade for fire resistance potions
netherSurvival.ancientDebris: Mine at Y=15 with beds for explosions or TNT

endgameGoals.dragonFight: Destroy crystals first, then bow + sword combo
endgameGoals.elytra: Explore end cities with rockets and ender pearls
endgameGoals.shulkerBoxes: Essential for inventory management - farm shulkers
endgameGoals.beacon: Full beacon with Haste II for massive building projects
